features.feature_name: App-level default service account configuration
features.feature_summary: App Engine now allows any configured project service account to be used as the app-level default service account during app creation and updates.
features.extended_definition: In App Engine Flexible Environment, the app-level default service account is a project service account configured at app creation or updated later, which becomes the default identity used by deployed app services when no per-version service account is configured. The feature supports using any service account in the Cloud project as that app-level account, and only versions deployed after an update begin using the new app-level default service account. If no app-level service account is configured, the auto-created App Engine default service account is used.
features.evidence_summary: These official App Engine flexible docs provide explicit steps and rules for setting and updating the app-level default service account, its fallback behavior, and the scope of its use across services versus per-version overrides.

You can customize liveness check requests by adding an optional liveness check section to your app.yaml file, for example: liveness check : path : "/liveness check" check interval sec : 30 timeout sec : 4 failure threshold : 2 success threshold : 2 The following settings are available for liveness checks: Field Default Range (Minimum-Maximum) Description path None If you want liveness checks to be forwarded to your application container, specify a URL path, such as "/liveness check" timeout sec 4 seconds 1-300 Timeout interval for each request, in seconds. check interval sec 30 seconds 1-300 Time interval between checks, in seconds.
